title: In crude Ohio rally speech, Trump says he may not help if Democrats win
summary: Trump made controversial remarks at an Ohio rally, threatening potential non-cooperation if Democrats win in the state's competitive Senate race. Ohio is one of eight key battleground states where campaigns are focusing on data center policy and cultural issues.
content: Ohio's is among eight U.S. Senate races rated competitive. The state has turned into a campaign battlefield over data centers and culture war issues.

zh.title: 特朗普在俄亥俄州粗俗的集会演讲中称，如果民主党获胜，他可能不会提供帮助
zh.summary: 特朗普在俄亥俄州集会上发表有争议的言论，威胁如果民主党在该州竞争激烈的参议院竞选中获胜，他将可能不予合作。俄亥俄州是八个关键摇摆州之一，各竞选活动专注于数据中心政策和文化问题。

title: Tens of thousands protest across Spain over housing crisis
summary: Massive protests have erupted across Spain in response to the country's acute housing shortage and affordability crisis. The demonstrations may prompt Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez to call a snap election in November after his proposed housing reform legislation failed to pass parliament.
content: Spanish media say Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez might call a snap election for November after proposed housing legislation failed in parliament.

zh.title: 数万人在西班牙各地抗议住房危机
zh.summary: 西班牙各地爆发了大规模抗议活动，以应对该国严重的住房短缺和可承受性危机。在他提议的住房改革法案未能在议会通过后，这些示威活动可能促使总理佩德罗·桑切斯在11月召集提前选举。

title: Singapore debuts a state-backed dating app for young government workers as it works to slow a demographic crisis
summary: Singapore has launched a government-backed dating application targeting young public sector employees as part of efforts to address the nation's critically low fertility rate. The initiative reflects the government's recognition that demographic decline poses a significant long-term challenge to the city-state's economy and sustainability.
content: Singapore's government is playing matchmaker for young public officials against a backdrop of ultra-low fertility.

zh.title: 新加坡为年轻政府公务员推出国家支持的约会应用程序，以应对人口危机
zh.summary: 新加坡推出了一款由政府支持的约会应用程序，针对年轻公共部门员工，作为解决该国极低生育率努力的一部分。该举措反映了政府的认识，即人口下降对城市国家的经济和可持续性构成了重大的长期挑战。

title: Ukraine’s surprise robot offensive exposes a vulnerability in Putin’s war machine
summary: Ukraine launched a surprise offensive employing robotic systems that has revealed weaknesses in Russian military capabilities on the battlefield. While military experts caution it is not a decisive breakthrough, the operation demonstrates how Ukraine's increasingly sophisticated use of autonomous and robotic technology is fundamentally changing the nature of frontline combat.
content: Experts say the offensive is not a decisive breakthrough, but demonstrates how Ukraine’s expanding use of robotic systems is reshaping frontline warfare.

zh.title: 乌克兰出其不意的机器人攻势暴露了普京战争机器的弱点
zh.summary: 乌克兰发动了采用机器人系统的突然攻势,暴露了俄罗斯在战场上军事能力的弱点。尽管军事专家表示这还不是决定性突破,但该行动表明乌克兰日益先进的自主机器人技术使用正在从根本上改变前线作战的性质。

title: The government can take 15% of Social Security benefits to repay student loans. These proposals seek to stop it.
summary: The federal government can offset Social Security benefits to recover student loan debt, and lawmakers are proposing legislation to prevent this practice. As debt burdens among older Americans continue to rise, these proposals aim to protect retirement income from reduction for debt repayment.
content: Debt among older Americans is rising, both in terms of the number of older households carrying debt and the amount borrowed.

zh.title: 政府可以扣押15%的社会保障福利来偿还学生贷款。这些提案旨在阻止这一做法。
zh.summary: 联邦政府可以抵消社会保障福利以收回学生贷款债务，议员们正在提议立法来防止这种做法。随着年长美国人的债务负担继续上升，这些提案旨在保护退休收入免受债务偿还的缩减。
